sentences.text: On careful perusal of the allegations made  in the FIR, it appears that the applicant is the driver  and the allegations against him are restricted only to  the extent of driving the vehicle at the relevant time.
Except this there is no evidence against him.
Considering the role of the present applicant, I am  inclined to grant anticipatory bail to him on certain  conditions.
Hence, following order.
ORDER 1.
Application is hereby allowed.

2. In the event of arrest of the applicant- Sandip Satish Jaiswal in connection with Crime No.I-404 of 2018 registered at Ambad Police Station, Tq. Ambad, District Jalna, for the offences punishable under sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code and u/s 59 of the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/- (Rs. Fifteen thousand) with one surety of the like amount, on the following conditions :-
a] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
aaa/-
4 ABA 64.2019.odt b] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 8 am to 11 am till filing of the charge sheet.
